name: RITES
purpose: Human continuity infrastructure for identity, relationships, wishes, responsibilities, transitions, archives and legacy.
identity_model: Inherits the canonical Carbon Actual human, entity, relationship and # contracts; RITES does not define a competing identity system.
authority_model: Human authority and consent govern consequential continuity actions; product intelligence and agents act only through explicit delegation.
abba_role: RITES product intelligence/orchestration boundary under canonical ABBA.
pulse_model: Continuity events, transitions, requests and evidence use canonical Pulse/event/proof contracts.
value_measurement_model: Measures continuity, documentary, relational, temporal, asset and service value independently from money.
provenance_model: Consequential records retain actor, authority context, origin, time, relationship and outcome provenance.
security_model: Uses canonical identity, authorization, audit, data lifecycle and Ash/Phoenix controls.
recovery_model: Continuity recovery requires verified identity, recovery authority, provenance and reconstruction from authoritative state.
data_lifecycle: Continuity data uses explicit active, archived, transitioned and disposed states with governed retention and consent.
